provenance: Authored from the natural-language statement by the benchmark author BEFORE running the compiler on the hamiltonian arm. Where the compiler disagrees with this file, the disagreement is a finding, not a reason to edit this file.

ground_truth.reason: the quantified binder i shadows the module-level index i

distractors: Assuming the inner i simply refers to the outer index. It does not: the quantifier introduces a new binder, and every reference to i inside the body resolves to it.
Treating the collision as a style warning. A warning does not prevent a silent scope change; design decision D-006 makes it an error.
